title: Finite reduction of the proper compact-cohomology unit
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, an integer $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and integers $N\geq j\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^N$ and $B=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^j$, with the quotient map $A\to B$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, with the constant-coefficient small pro-etale derived categories and $D^b_{ctf}$ conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. For a complex $M$ write $rM=M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$, using derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $h:X\to X$ be a $k$-endomorphism and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$. Write $Lh_A^*$ and $Lh_B^*$ for derived pullback at the two coefficient rings [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and $\mu_{h,K}:r(Lh_A^*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_B^*(rK)$ for the canonical coefficient/pullback comparison of [lem-fix-operation-reduction].

Assume $h$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put $H_R(M)=R\Gamma_c(X,M)$ for $R=A,B$. Let
$$
b_{h,R,M}:H_R(M)\xrightarrow{H_R(\eta_{h,R,M})}H_R(Rh_{*,R}Lh_R^*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_R(Rh_{!,R}Lh_R^*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_R(Lh_R^*M)
$$
be the unit/proper-comparison arrow of [prop-trf-graph-operator]; here $\eta_h$ is the unit of $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$, the middle arrow is the canonical proper identification, and the last arrow is compact-support composition for $a_Xh=a_X$.
For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ let
$$
\beta_M:rH_A(M)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_B(rM)
$$
be compact-support coefficient change [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change] followed by the natural point-sections comparison [lem-trf-point-sections-finite-reduction] through $\operatorname{Fib}_s=\Gamma(s,-)$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Since $Lh_A^*K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ by clause (i) of [thm-sf-ctf-stability], $\beta_{Lh_A^*K}$ is defined; put $\widetilde\beta_K=H_B(\mu_{h,K})\circ\beta_{Lh_A^*K}$. Then the actual unit/proper-composition arrows commute with reduction:
$$
\widetilde\beta_K\circ r(b_{h,A,K})=b_{h,B,rK}\circ\beta_K
\quad\text{in }D(B).
$$
This comparison is natural in $K$.

source.place: Proof (3), global operator paragraph: the sentence that the coefficient comparison is natural in the complex and compatible with pullback and the compact-support transport; the preserved split implements that transport by the proper graph unit b_h.
